domainConclusions.statement: Current profile-driven Director and durable chat wrappers are useful legacy execution, not the planned model-authored sequence/range DAG plus exact CAP-2 tool loop.
ProjectService prepare/finalize state transitions are atomic and research sandbox execution is isolated, but no production planner, editor or renderer connects them.
Template HTML, AI MG codegen/jobs and generalized GeneratedCompositionProgram remain separate systems; shared concepts do not establish convergence.
Baseline/deep analysis produces useful layered evidence, but no production policy derives and verifies the exact evidence required by a requested target claim and candidate operation.
MG, deep-analysis, editorial-intent and reference-style jobs have meaningful claims, leases and retries, but no shared canonical plan/session authority exists.
